title: Injectivity of Sign Monomials
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, the map sending a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ to the character $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ is injective.
